entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you that stalker!? Haven't you ever[n]stopped to consider how your ex feels?
entries.uk: То це ти той сталкер?! Ти хоч раз[n]замислювався, як почувається твоя[n]колишня?

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: She's my property! I can do whatever[n]I want with her!
entries.uk: Вона моя власність! Що хочу, те з нею[n]й роблю!

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: It's not like she didn't treat me like[n]a plaything! What's wrong with me[n]doing the same!?
entries.uk: Вона ж сама гралася мною, як іграшкою![n]То чому мені не можна так само?!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You can't treat someone like[n]shit just 'cause they did it to you![n]What a load of crap...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're gonna change the hearts of all the[n]bastards like you!

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: There are millions of people far worse[n]than me!

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: What about Madarame...? He stole[n]everything from me, but you're letting[n]him off the hook!?
entries.uk: А як же Мадараме?.. Він украв у мене[n]все, а йому ви це так і подаруєте?!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Madarame? The hell's this guy goin' on[n]about?
